scope: CAPR training configuration used by scripts/train_capr.py.

optimizer.name: AdamW
optimizer.parameters: adapter only; anchor parameters and BatchNorm statistics frozen

dataset.name: poisson.bin
dataset.input: normalize by spatial maximum (divisor 1 if maximum is zero)
dataset.target: face-zero absolute kernel + 1e-10, normalized to unit sum

post_hoc_sensitivity.scope: Single-training-seed sensitivity study, separate from the main checkpoint.
post_hoc_sensitivity.selection_criterion: Same original FP32 risk-aware validation score; not a deployment metric ranking.
post_hoc_sensitivity.deployment_metrics: Frozen FP16 evaluation on the same ordered 10,000 Poisson validation records.
